title: Around the World in 24 Hours: Probing LLM Knowledge of Time and Place

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model accuracy on geotemporal reasoning tasks (TIMEPLACE and TIMETIMEPLACE) aggregated by start and target countries, continents, and Western versus Non-Western regions.
Analyzing model performance differences on geotemporal tasks across geographic locations aggregated by varying national or city-level income levels.
Aggregating and evaluating model reasoning accuracy based on the population sizes and densities of the queried geographic locations.

Measuring the correlation between model accuracy and the perplexity of location names (using a static sentence template) to determine if models exhibit a performance bias toward locations that likely appear more frequently in their training data.
